ch.s: Verses 1–8: “Now it was that the high priest Simon bowed his knees near the holy place, spread out his hands in reverent form, and uttered the following prayer”; Verses 9–16: “You, O King, when you created the immeasurable and measureless earth, chose this city. bg: A maritime city of Galilee (Acts 21:7). It was originally called "Accho" (q.v.), and received the name Ptolemais from Ptolemy Soter when he was in possession of Coele-Syria.
ch.s: Verses 1–6: ““King Ptolemy Philopator to the commanders throughout Egypt, and to all who are set over affairs, joy and strength.”; Verses 7–12: “and taking into consideration their constancy and fidelity toward us and toward our ancestors, we have, as we ought, acquitted them of every sort of charge.”; Verses 13–18: “Their priests, then, as it was appropriate, saluted him with good wishes, and all the people echoed with the “Hallelujah!” Then they joyfully departed.”; Verses 19–23: “They were accordingly brought back in peace, while they gave utterance to appropriate thanks; and they determined to observe these days during their sojourn as days of joyfulness.”.
